full_judgment: 6. Khandker Mahbubuddin Ahmed, the learned Counsel, appearing for the appellants, argues that abnormally low consideration of Tk. 3,000/- for sale of 5'29 acres of land raised presumption of fraud and misrepresentation. He further argues that the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division erred in law in interfering with the findings of fact arrived at by the first appellate Court on consideration of all evidence on record.
